ipa.financial_contracts.cds.PricingParameters

API endpoint for Financial Contract analytics, that returns calculations relevant to each contract type.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.cds.PricingParameters.

Syntax

PricingParameters(
    *,
    cash_amount_in_deal_ccy: float | None = None,
    clean_price_percent: float | None = None,
    conventional_spread_bp: float | None = None,
    market_data_date: str | date | datetime | timedelta | None = None,
    report_ccy: str | None = None,
    upfront_amount_in_deal_ccy: float | None = None,
    upfront_percent: float | None = None,
    valuation_date: str | date | datetime | timedelta | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
cash_amount_in_deal_ccy float | None No None cash_amount_in_deal_ccy to override and that will be used as pricing analysis input to compute the cds other outputs. Optional. No override is applied by default. Note that only one pricing analysis input should be defined.
clean_price_percent float | None No None clean_price_percent to override and that will be used as pricing analysis input to compute the cds other outputs. Optional. No override is applied by default. Note that only one pricing analysis input should be defined.
conventional_spread_bp float | None No None conventional_spread_bp to override and that will be used as pricing analysis input to compute the cds other outputs. Optional. No override is applied by default. Note that only one pricing analysis input should be defined.
market_data_date str | date | datetime | timedelta | None No None The market data date for pricing. Optional. By default, the market_data_date date is the valuation_date or Today
report_ccy str | None No None The reporting currency code, expressed in iso 4217 alphabetical format (e.g., 'usd'). it is set for the fields ending with 'xxxinreportccy'. optional. the default value is the notional currency.
upfront_amount_in_deal_ccy float | None No None upfront_amount_in_deal_ccy to override and that will be used as pricing analysis input to compute the cds other outputs. Optional. No override is applied by default. Note that only one pricing analysis input should be defined.
upfront_percent float | None No None upfront_percent to override and that will be used as pricing analysis input to compute the cds other outputs. Optional. No override is applied by default. Note that only one pricing analysis input should be defined.
valuation_date str | date | datetime | timedelta | None No None The valuation date for pricing. Optional. If not set the valuation date is equal to market_data_date or Today. For assets that contains a settlementConvention, the default valuation date is equal to the settlementdate of the Asset that is usually the TradeDate+SettlementConvention.
